g.text: PR #2539 · Add the session menu to the mobile Sessions sheet
Phones render no session rail, so stop, pause, leave and close were unreachable;
now each Sessions sheet row opens the rail's own menu as a bottom action sheet.
BEFORE
SessionRail (desktop only)
Owns the menu state and its four dialogs:
rename, share, schedule, fork.
page.rs: if !is_mobile_dashboard
At 768 px and below the rail is not rendered.
Its menu, and every action in it, goes with it.
MobileReady Sessions sheet
Rows offer Open, Mark read and Mute only.
No stop, pause, hide, leave, share or close.
AFTER
use_session_menu (menu_host.rs)
One hook owns the menu state and dialogs;
SessionRail and MobileReady both call it.
Row button: Session actions (ready-menu)
Same SessionRailMenu, same two-tap confirms.
Close sends DELETE only on the second tap.
Bottom action sheet inside the sheet
Full width, scrolls; stacks above the sheet.
A tap outside closes only the menu.
The rail's own dropdown placement on desktop is unchanged; WebKit/iPhone was not exercised locally (Chromium only).
